name: Dank Meme Sounds
description: Gives AI agents 38,000+ meme sound effects (vine boom, bruh, sad violin, airhorn) with AI-written metadata (meaning, origin, when to use it, moods, use cases), so an agent can describe a moment and get the right reaction sound. Tools: find_reaction_sound, search_sounds, get_trending_sounds, get_sound, get_random_sound, list_categories, browse_sounds, list_filters, and play_sound for local playback. Free, no API key.
author: HalberdLLC

DANKMACHINE_API.description: Optional base URL of the catalog API the local server reads.
